raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 was delivered twice: a 05:00 re-send repeats all 338 transactions of the 02:00 delivery, with txn_ts written as epoch milliseconds (1768716261000 ms = 2026-01-18 06:04:21 UTC, an exact match of the original row). That format breaks the TIMESTAMP cast, and the copies would double-count batch 14 even if the cast succeeded. The fix parses both txn_ts formats and keeps one row per txn_id, the earliest ingested.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.87, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH parsed AS (SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, status, ingest_ts, COALESCE(TRY_CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP), epoch_ms(TRY_CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT))) AS ts FROM raw_transactions), dedup AS (SELECT * FROM parsed QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts ASC) = 1) SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, ts AS txn_ts, CAST(ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM dedup WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
